gloss: ideation technique; method of generating ideas

definitions.gloss: ideation technique; method of generating ideas
definitions.explanation: A structured method for producing new ideas or ways of thinking, such as brainstorming or mind mapping. Compound of {発想|はっそう} (conception, idea) + {法|ほう} (method).

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{発想法|はっそうほう}を{学|まな}ぶ。
examples.english: I'm learning a new ideation technique.

examples.japanese: マインドマップは{人気|にんき}のある{発想法|はっそうほう}だ。
examples.english: Mind mapping is a popular ideation technique.

examples.japanese: {行|い}き{詰|づ}まったときは、{視点|してん}を{変|か}える{発想法|はっそうほう}が{役|やく}に{立|た}つ。
examples.english: When you hit a wall, an ideation technique that shifts your perspective is useful.

notes:
Compound of {発想|はっそう} (conception, idea) + {法|ほう} (method). Refers to a named or systematic approach to producing ideas.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {発想法|はっそうほう}を{学|まな}ぶ: to learn an ideation technique
- {新|あたら}しい{発想法|はっそうほう}: a new ideation technique
- {発想法|はっそうほう}を{取|と}り{入|い}れる: to adopt an ideation technique

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {発想|はっそう}: idea; conception — the idea itself, not the method for generating it
- {手法|しゅほう}: technique; approach — broader, any method, not specific to producing ideas
